title: AkSpend bank SMS test corpus
scope: Broad Indian bank and payment-message coverage; not an exhaustive list of all banks or verified production templates.
notes: All account numbers, merchants, references, contacts and OTPs here are fictional placeholders. Never call numbers or open links from fixtures.
Bank-specific debit/credit pairs are synthetic common-grammar fixtures, not evidence that those banks issue these exact templates.
Sender values prefixed TEST- are illustrative labels, not verified DLT headers. Do not copy them into a production allowlist. The same sender family can be ambiguous.
Adapted public examples preserve message structure but replace identifiers and some wording. Their dates may omit a year; do not invent one without SMS metadata.
Expected amounts are decimal strings, not floating-point numbers. Currency must be retained; never assume foreign amounts are INR.
debit/credit describe account movement, not necessarily expense/income. Require confirmation for transfers, repayments, refunds, cash movement and unknown counterparties.
auto_book is false for all fixtures by design. This corpus does not authorize posting transactions.
Messages marked ignore may still be useful to a bill/reminder feature but must not create ledger purchases.
Historical bank labels do not assert current products, regulatory status or availability.
This file contains data only and does not change AkSpend permissions, runtime behavior or dependencies.

sources.use: Seven adapted structural examples; not bank-verified.

classification_guide.ignore: Must not book a ledger transaction.
classification_guide.uncertain: Insufficient or contradictory evidence; manual review.
classification_guide.refund: Link to original purchase; avoid double counting.
classification_guide.transfer_candidate: Confirm ownership and match account movements.
classification_guide.investment_transfer_candidate: Potential movement into an investment account.
classification_guide.cashback: Reward credit; keep distinct from refund.

sender_test_cases.expected: Bank-like structure only; verify trusted family, never authenticate solely from shape.
Synthetic personal-number sender; do not auto-book bank-like text.
